title.en: An Act Authorizing the Sum of One Million One Hundred Sixty-Five Thousand Pesos for Breeding Stations in the Philippines
title.orig: An Act Authorizing the Sum of One Million One Hundred Sixty-Five Thousand Pesos for Breeding Stations in the Philippines

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3097_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, the sum of one million one hundred sixty-five thousand pesos is hereby authorized for the establishment and improvement of animal breeding stations in the Philippines, said sum to be apportioned as follows:
1. Animal Breeding Station, Uigan City ₱50,000.00
2. Animal Breeding Station, Gattaran, Cagayan 50,000.00
3.Animal Breeding Station, Balamban, Cebu 50,000.00
4.Animal Breeding Station, Bago Oshiro, Davao City 50,000.00
5.Animal Breeding Station, General Santos , Cotabato 50,000.00
6.Animal Breeding Station , Murcia , Negros Occidental 50,000.00
7.Animal Breeding Station, Rizal, Zam- boanga del Norte 50,000,00
8.Improvements for the Ilocos Sur Animal Breeding Center , Santa Maria , Ilocos Sur 15,000.00
9.Animal Breeding Station, Magalang, Pampanga 50,000.00
10.Animal Breeding Station, San Ilde- fonso, Bulacan 50,000.00
11.Animal Breeding Station Las Navas, Samar 50,000.00
12.Animal Breeding Station, Laongan, Pambujan, Samar 50,000.00
13.Animal Breeding Station, Can-avid, Samar 50,000.00
14.Animal Breeding Station, Kabayan, Benguet, Mt. Province 50,000.00
15.Animal Breeding Station, Tabuk, Kalinga, Mt. Province 50,000.00
16.Animal Breeding Station, San Jose , Negros Oriental 50,000.00
17.Animal Breeding Station, Siaton Negros Oriental 50,000.00
18.Animal Breeding Station, Argao, Cebu 50,000.00
19.Animal Breeding Station, Cabagan, Isabela 50,000.00
20.Animal Breeding Station, Lambunao, Iloilo 50,000.00
21.Animal Breeding Station, Nuling, Cota- bato 50,000.00
22.Animal Breeding Station, Villaba and Tabango, Leyte 50,000.00
23.Animal Breeding Station, Trece Mar- tires City, Cavite 50,000.00
24.Animal Breeding Station, San Pascual,Masbate 50,000.00

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 17, 1961.
